commit.message:
feat(ops): one machining-frame seam - OpFrame composes part_alignment and TiltedFrame

Phase 1 of #763: OpFrame (crates/app/src/operation/frame.rs) is the one
machining-frame seam - the setup's part_alignment (#326) and the op's
3+2 Tilt (M5.1 B) composed behind one door. collect_job reads material
and heights through it and builds its tilt frame from
OpFrame::checked_frame (one construction site, the refusal keeping its
exact words and precedence). Heights and bounds in the local frame
resolve against fully transformed geometry, never a z - origin.z shift.

No refusal lifted, no post change, no generator change; behavior is
byte-identical (the zero-tilt index reproduces the prismatic path
exactly, move for move).

Tests: crates/app/tests/opframe_seam.rs (8) + the seam's inline unit
tests (6) - identity, zero-tilt exactness, tilted plane run, 90/180
alignment, alignment x tilt composition, transformed local heights and
boxes, picks' Phase 1 refusal boundary. Battery green: plane_align (9),
plane_align_edges (5), axis_align (10), points_align (8), turn_pivot
(5), area_controls (13), after_op (10), inverted_post (15 - the
capability gates), rest_across_setups (7), carried_verify (8). Clippy
clean on camcraft-app.

Refs #763
